package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	lessonexampleuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonexample"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// LessonExamplesHandler handles first-class lesson examples.
type LessonExamplesHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	ReplaceUC lessonexampleuc.ReplaceLessonExamples
	ListUC    lessonexampleuc.ListLessonExamples
	DeleteUC  lessonexampleuc.DeleteLessonExample
	Access    contentaccess.Service
}

type lessonExampleTranslationRequest struct {
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Title       string `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Description string `json:"description" validate:"required"`
}

type lessonExampleRequest struct {
	ID             string                            `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	SourceKey      string                            `json:"source_key" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Order          int                               `json:"order" validate:"required,min=1,max=32767"`
	Status         *int                              `json:"status" validate:"required,oneof=0 1"`
	Mode           string                            `json:"mode" validate:"required,max=128"`
	PrimaryStack   *string                           `json:"primary_stack" validate:"omitempty,max=128"`
	Stacks         []string                          `json:"stacks" validate:"required,min=1,dive,required,max=128"`
	TargetConcepts []string                          `json:"target_concepts" validate:"required,min=1,dive,required,max=128"`
	Translations   []lessonExampleTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"required,min=2,dive"`
}

type replaceLessonExamplesRequest struct {
	Examples []lessonExampleRequest `json:"examples" validate:"required,dive"`
}

func (h LessonExamplesHandler) Replace(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req replaceLessonExamplesRequest
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	examples := make([]domain.LessonExample, 0, len(req.Examples))
	for _, item := range req.Examples {
		translations := make([]domain.LessonExampleI18n, 0, len(item.Translations))
		for _, translation := range item.Translations {
			translations = append(translations, domain.LessonExampleI18n{
				I18nID:      translation.I18nID,
				Title:       translation.Title,
				Description: translation.Description,
			})
		}
		examples = append(examples, domain.LessonExample{
			ID:             item.ID,
			SourceKey:      item.SourceKey,
			Order:          item.Order,
			Status:         *item.Status,
			Mode:           item.Mode,
			PrimaryStack:   item.PrimaryStack,
			Stacks:         item.Stacks,
			TargetConcepts: item.TargetConcepts,
			Translations:   translations,
		})
	}
	if err := h.ReplaceUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID"), examples); err != nil {
		writeLessonExampleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h LessonExamplesHandler) ListAdmin(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.list(w, r, false)
}

func (h LessonExamplesHandler) ListPublic(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.Access.RequireLesson(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID"), r.URL.Query().Get(relationAccessQueryParam)); err != nil {
		writeContentAccessError(w, err)
		return
	}
	h.list(w, r, true)
}

func (h LessonExamplesHandler) list(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, activeOnly bool) {
	examples, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID"), activeOnly)
	if err != nil {
		writeLessonExampleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"lesson_examples": examples})
}

func (h LessonExamplesHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "exampleID")); err != nil {
		writeLessonExampleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func writeLessonExampleError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
	default:
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}
}
